Yeah, this is-- this is something that occupies a lot of our time, because as you can imagine property tax is the largest source of revenue for the city. And right now we’re trying to be, from our perspective, very conservative in a sense of we’re assuming that we’re going to pick up 23 percent and then stay above 20 percent over the life of the financial plan. You know, we’re hoping that all the new laws that were enacted by the state would help us in term of a conversion.
